papers.title: Grazing cements kelp collapse
Tiny ciliate introns
Recordanelles capture transient gene expression in single human cells
papers.abstract: RNA sequencing can capture high-resolution snapshots of a cell’s transcriptome, but transient changes in individual cells cannot be captured over long periods at a transcriptome-wide scale. Now, a synthetic organelle termed the ‘recordanelle’ can record cellular RNAs in cells for several days and be read with single-cell sensitivity.
papers.titleZh: Recordanelle 記錄單一人類細胞的短暫基因表現
papers.summaryZh: 研究團隊提出一種名為 recordanelle 的合成胞器。該胞器可在細胞內記錄細胞 RNA，持續數天，並以單細胞靈敏度讀取。RNA 定序雖能提供細胞轉錄體的高解析度快照，但無法在長期間以轉錄體全尺度捕捉單一細胞的短暫變化。此方法提供長時間記錄單細胞 RNA 的可能性。

papers.title: Human Argonaute 2 is a programmable targeting domain for RNA editing
papers.abstract: ALTER is a programmable RNA base editor built entirely from human proteins. By using human AGO2 instead of bacterial CRISPR–Cas proteins, ALTER mitigates a key risk factor for harmful immune responses in therapeutic applications while also proving generally more effective than dCas13-based editors.
papers.titleZh: 人類 Argonaute 2 成為 RNA 編輯的可程式化靶向結構域
papers.summaryZh: 研究團隊開發了名為 ALTER 的可程式化 RNA 基礎編輯器，其組件完全來自人類蛋白質。該系統使用人類 AGO2 取代細菌來源的 CRISPR–Cas 蛋白作為靶向結構域。相較於使用細菌蛋白的系統，此設計可減輕治療應用中有害免疫反應的關鍵風險因子。研究指出 ALTER 在效果上普遍優於以 dCas13 為基礎的編輯器。

papers.title: Keratin 9 regulates mechanosensitive YAP1 signalling in palmoplantar epidermis
papers.abstract: Steiner et al. propose that keratin 9 (K9) interacts with 14-3-3, sequestering YAP1 in the cytoplasm and inhibiting YAP1 activity. They identify dysregulated YAP in palmoplantar keratinization diseases, with K9 as a downstream regulator of YAP.
papers.titleZh: 角蛋白9調控掌跖表皮機械敏感YAP1訊號
papers.summaryZh: Steiner等人提出角蛋白9（K9）與14-3-3交互作用，將YAP1滯留於細胞質並抑制YAP1活性。研究指出掌跖角化疾病中YAP呈現失調。K9被認為是YAP的下游調控因子。該發現連結了角蛋白與機械敏感YAP1訊號在掌跖表皮中的關係。

papers.title: Network geometry shapes the transformation of task representations across the human cortex
papers.abstract: The dimensionality of intrinsic brain connectivity systematically shapes how task representations compress and expand across the cortex, and activity flow modeling shows the active role of network geometry in generating the transformation.
papers.titleZh: 網路幾何形塑任務表徵在人類大腦皮質的轉變
papers.summaryZh: 本研究指出，人類大腦內在連結的維度會系統性地影響任務表徵在皮質中如何壓縮與擴張。研究發現這種壓縮與擴張的模式與網路幾何相關。利用活動流建模，研究顯示網路幾何在產生此轉變中扮演主動角色。該結果連結了內在腦連結結構與任務表徵在皮質間的轉換。

papers.title: Behavioral genomics identifies Creld1 as a cross-modal regulator of somatosensation
papers.abstract: Jiang et al. developed a robust postnatal knockout platform for somatosensory genomics and behavioral screening, identifying Creld1 as a cross-modal regulator of somatosensation through its control of sensory neuron excitability via voltage-gated sodium channels.
papers.titleZh: 行為基因體學發現 Creld1 為體感跨模態調控因子
papers.summaryZh: Jiang 等人建立了用於體感基因體學與行為篩選的穩健出生後基因敲除平台。透過該平台的篩選，他們鑑定出 Creld1 為體感的跨模態調控因子。研究指出 Creld1 透過調控感覺神經元的興奮性發揮作用，其機制涉及電壓門控鈉離子通道。該發現連結了基因體層面的篩選與體感功能調控。

papers.title: Serine protease inhibitor A3 is a soluble SIRPα ligand that suppresses inflammation and antitumor immunity
papers.abstract: Here the authors show that SERPINA3 is a soluble SIRPα ligand with immunosuppressive and therapeutic activity against inflammatory and autoimmune diseases, whereas cancer cells overexpress SERPINA3 and blocking it can be protective.
papers.titleZh: 絲氨酸蛋白酶抑制劑A3為可溶性SIRPα配體，抑制發炎與抗腫瘤免疫
papers.summaryZh: 研究指出SERPINA3是一種可溶性SIRPα配體，具有免疫抑制作用。作者顯示其對發炎與自體免疫疾病具有治療活性。另一方面，癌細胞會過度表現SERPINA3。阻斷SERPINA3在該情境下可產生保護作用。

papers.title: A toxic friendship drives gut dysmotility
papers.abstract: Fusobacterium nucleatum-derived 2-hydroxybutyrate promotes toxin expression by enterotoxigenic Bacteroides fragilis in the mouse gut, which drives persistent enteric neuron loss and intestinal dysmotility long after bacterial infection is cleared.
papers.titleZh: 有毒友誼驅動腸道運動障礙
papers.summaryZh: 研究指出，Fusobacterium nucleatum 所產生的 2-羥基丁酸會促進腸道中的產毒性 Bacteroides fragilis 表現毒素。該作用發生在小鼠腸道中，並導致腸神經元持續性流失與腸道運動功能異常。值得注意的是，這種腸道運動障礙在細菌感染清除後仍持續存在。結果顯示兩種細菌間的交互作用可能與長期腸道功能受損有關。

papers.title: Steroid hormones produced by coral-associated Endozoicomonas influence coral immune response during thermal stress
papers.abstract: Multi-omics and laboratory experiments reveal that a coral-associated bacterium can produce testosterone and progesterone; these two hormones alter the coral host’s innate immune responses during thermal stress.
papers.titleZh: 珊瑚共生菌 Endozoicomonas 產生的類固醇激素影響熱壓力下免疫反應
papers.summaryZh: 多體學與實驗室實驗顯示，一種與珊瑚共生的細菌 Endozoicomonas 能產生睪固酮與黃體素。這兩種激素會改變珊瑚宿主在熱壓力下的先天免疫反應。研究指出共生菌產生的類固醇激素與珊瑚對熱壓力的免疫調控有關。

papers.title: Host–virus interactions dominate fitness and conceal additive genetic variation
papers.abstract: Host–parasite coevolution is expected to generate strong selection for resistance and infectivity that has the potential to erode genetic variation. Despite this, natural populations often retain extensive genetic variation in these traits. Genotype-by-genotype interactions on fitness can generate negative frequency-dependent selection, which helps maintain this variation by preventing any host or pathogen genotype from retaining a permanent advantage. Because these interactions place genetic variance in the interaction term rather than in additive differences among hosts or pathogens, that variance is masked from directional selection and can remain ‘cryptic’. Here we combine coevolutionary modelling with large‑scale experimental infection assays to quantify how host-pathogen interactions structure fitness variance in a vertically transmitted virus system, Drosophila melanogaster and sigma virus. Simulations show that coevolution typically erodes additive genetic variance in host and pathogen fitness, concentrating variance in host-virus interaction terms. Consistent with these predictions, experiments spanning 90 host-virus genotype combinations reveal that transmission, viral load, and virulence are overwhelmingly governed by host-virus genetic interactions rather than host or virus main effects. As a result, neither host resistance alleles nor viral genotypes confer consistently higher fitness across genetic backgrounds. Interactions tend to be sex‑specific, further limiting heritable fitness variation. Our results demonstrate that coevolution can substantially mask heritable genetic variation from directional selection by rendering fitness context-dependent. This extensive cryptic genetic variation may be revealed either when ecological or evolutionary conditions shift, or when the process of coevolution itself alters the direction of selection. This demonstrates the need to account for genotype-specific interactions when forecasting evolutionary responses.
papers.titleZh: 宿主-病毒交互作用主導適存度並掩蓋加性遺傳變異
papers.summaryZh: 本研究結合共同演化模型與大規模實驗感染，量化宿主-病原交互作用如何塑造垂直傳播病毒系統 Drosophila melanogaster 與 sigma virus 的適存度變異。模擬顯示共同演化通常會侵蝕宿主與病原適存度的加性遺傳變異，使變異集中於宿主-病毒交互作用項。涵蓋 90 組宿主-病毒基因型組合的實驗發現，傳播率、病毒量與毒力主要受宿主-病毒遺傳交互作用支配，而非宿主或病毒的主效應。結果顯示，無論是宿主抗性等位基因或病毒基因型，都不會在不同遺傳背景下持續帶來較高適存度，且交互作用傾向具性別特異性，進一步限制可遺傳的適存度變異。

papers.title: A cortical semantic map integrates fractions and integers in the human brain
papers.abstract: How does the human brain represent the meaning of abstract symbols? Some theories postulate the existence of semantic spaces where concepts occupy positions that reflect their conceptual relationships. In the number domain, psychological evidence suggests that integers are represented along a mental number line which, with education, integrates higher-level number concepts such as fractions. To test this hypothesis, we recorded whole-brain 7T fMRI responses to integer and fraction symbols during an active magnitude comparison task designed to engage magnitude processing. Consistent with predictions, we found both behavioral and neural numerical distance effects. Activation vectors in intraparietal, inferior temporal, prefrontal, hippocampal, and parahippocampal cortices formed a two-dimensional semantic space organized by numerical magnitude and domain (fractions versus integers). Gaussian fits revealed a topographic map of numerical preferences in the anterior inferior parietal cortex, common to both domains. Our results suggest that, when educated adults engage in an explicit magnitude comparison task, their brain can construct an ordered representation that integrates fractions and integers, with a topographic organization in the anterior IPS/IPL.
papers.titleZh: 大腦皮質語義地圖整合分數與整數
papers.summaryZh: 研究以 7T fMRI 記錄受試者在主動大小比較任務中對整數與分數符號的腦部反應。結果呈現行為與神經上的數值距離效應。內側頂葉、下顳葉、前額葉、海馬與海馬旁皮質的活化向量形成一個二維語義空間，其組織依據數值大小與領域分數對整數。Gaussian 擬合顯示前部下頂葉皮質存在共同於兩領域的數值偏好地形圖。研究結果顯示，受過教育的成人在執行明確的大小比較任務時，大腦可建構整合分數與整數且具地形組織的有序表徵。

papers.title: LMNA Haploinsufficiency in Human iPSC-Derived Cardiac Organoids Reveals Early Fibrotic Signaling as a Therapeutically Targetable Process
papers.abstract: LMNA mutations are a major cause of dilated cardiomyopathy (DCM), with haploinsufficiency representing a common pathogenic mechanism. Yet the earliest disease-initiating events remain poorly defined. Here, we identify a novel intronic splice-site variant, c.937-1G>A, that disrupts pre-mRNA splicing, induces nonsense-mediated mRNA decay, and results in LMNA haploinsufficiency. We differentiated induced pluripotent stem cells (iPSCs) generated from a patient's peripheral blood mononuclear cells (PBMCs) carrying this mutation into self-patterning human cardiac organoids to define the early consequences of reduced LMNA dosage in a multicellular human context. Single-nucleus transcriptomics revealed broad multicellular remodeling beyond the previously implicated fibroblast and cardiomyocyte populations. Functionally, LMNA-mutant organoids exhibited altered calcium handling and impaired contractility. These changes were accompanied by increased reactive oxygen species (ROS) and early pro-fibrotic signaling characterized by increased periostin (POSTN) secretion, CTGF expression, and increased p38 MAPK phosphorylation. Treatment with the antifibrotic drug nintedanib attenuated this response, partially rescued rhythmic beating, reduced POSTN secretion and CTGF expression, and broadly suppressed fibrosis-associated transcriptional programs. Together, these findings show that LMNA haploinsufficiency initiates multicellular cardiac remodeling and early targetable profibrotic signaling during human cardiac development, providing mechanistic insight into the earliest stages of LMNA-associated cardiomyopathy and establishing a human cardiac organoid platform for therapeutic discovery.
papers.titleZh: 人類 iPSC 衍生心臟類器官中的 LMNA 單倍體不足揭示了可作為治療標的的早期纖維化訊息傳遞過程

papers.title: Comparative Single-Cell Profiling of CRISPR Knockout and Interference Defines Modality-Specific Strengths in Functional Genomics
papers.abstract: Pooled CRISPR screens coupled with single-cell RNA sequencing enable high-throughput functional interrogation of gene regulatory networks, yet systematic comparisons of CRISPR knockout (CRISPRko) and CRISPR interference (CRISPRi) remain limited. We established a single-cell CRISPRko workflow and benchmarked it against CRISPRi using 87 sgRNAs targeting 29 unfolded protein response genes. CRISPRko generated transcriptional phenotypes highly concordant with CRISPRi, and induced comparable pathway-level responses albeit with distinct on-target and off-target effects between modalities. While CRISPRi allows direct assessment of target gene repression, CRISPRko provides an effective complementary approach for complete loss-of-function studies, expanding the toolkit for single-cell functional genomics.
papers.titleZh: 比較單細胞分析 CRISPR 敲除與干擾，定義功能基因體學中模態特異性優勢

papers.title: Genetic Determinants of Cell-Type-Specific Responses to Cardiotoxic Chemotherapeutic Agents
papers.abstract: Doxorubicin (DOX) and 5-fluorouracil (5-FU) are effective for treating a variety of cancers, yet many patients taking these drugs experience adverse cardiovascular events that are severe enough to pause treatment, often prolonging the course of chemotherapy and reducing its efficacy. Individual risk for drug-induced cardiotoxicity is likely mediated, at least in part, by genetic variants that control how the heart and vasculature respond to drug-induced perturbations. To identify loci associated with drug-induced cardiotoxicity, we developed an in vitro model that allows us to characterize the effects of chemotherapeutic drugs on a wide range of cardiac cell types, including cardiomyocytes, endothelial cells, and fibroblasts. Using single-cell RNA-seq, we profiled responses to DOX and 5-FU across 46 individuals and 14 cell types, identifying hundreds of expression quantitative trait loci that modify cardiovascular transcription in response to each drug (response eQTLs). Drug-responsive eQTL genes include genes that were previously linked to drug-induced cardiotoxicity and cardiovascular disease, such as ABCB4, HAS3, TNFRSF1A, and OGFR. Over a third of drug-responsive genes are shared between the DOX and 5-FU treatments, suggesting that genes predictive of DOX-induced cardiotoxicity may extend to 5-FU. Among the credible colocalizations we identified between GWAS signals and drug-response eQTLs, we discovered a locus associated with ischemic heart disease that is also a DOX-responsive eQTL for IL6R. IL6R was previously nominated as a druggable target for heart disease, and its binding partner IL6 is a candidate biomarker for anthracycline-induced cardiotoxicity. These findings advance the discovery of genetic variants underlying cardiotoxicity and support development of genotype-based predictors for treating cancer.
papers.titleZh: 心臟毒性化療藥物細胞類型特異性反應的遺傳決定因素

papers.title: LiverHomo: An Integrated and Interactive Human Liver Single-Cell Atlas with Protein Interaction and Cell-Cell Communication Networks
papers.abstract: LiverHomo is an integrated cell atlas developed from publicly available human liver single-cell RNA sequencing (scRNA-seq) datasets spanning healthy and diverse liver disease contexts. While several single-cell resources for the human liver are available, LiverHomo provides broad disease coverage and extends transcriptomic exploration through the integration of protein-protein interaction (PPI) networks and cell-cell interactions. LiverHomo provides an interactive web portal (https://liverhomo.org) for exploring cellular composition, gene expression, differentially expressed genes, Gene Ontology annotations, cell-cell interactions, and context-specific PPI networks across diseases and cell types. To facilitate intuitive access to these multidimensional data, the portal incorporates Ask LiverHomo, a natural-language assistant that interprets user queries and directs users to relevant analyses and visualizations. Interactive histograms, violin plots, network visualizations, and metadata exploration enable users to examine the atlas at cellular, transcriptomic, and protein-interaction levels, while the underlying data are readily accessible for further analysis. Together, LiverHomo provides an integrated and accessible resource for investigating cellular and molecular alterations across human liver health and disease.
papers.titleZh: LiverHomo：整合且互動的人類肝臟單細胞圖譜，含蛋白質交互作用與細胞間通訊網絡

papers.title: CCTP-Atlas: Compartment-Resolved Ciliary Transcriptional Dysregulation in Tetralogy of Fallot, A Six-Dataset Integrative Meta-Analysis
papers.abstract: Background. Primary cilia coordinate Hedgehog-dependent outflow tract morphogenesis. Concurrent human genetics implicates ciliary loss-of-function in nonsyndromic tetralogy of Fallot (TOF) risk, yet compartment-resolved ciliary transcriptional programmes in public TOF snRNA-seq remain unmapped at module resolution. Methods. We curated a Cardiac Ciliary Transcriptomic Panel (CCTP; 1,611 genes; four modules) and executed a ten-phase integrative pipeline on six public sc/snRNA-seq resources. Differentially expressed gene tables were harmonised (adjusted p < 0.05; |log2FC| [≥] 0.5 where available), mapped to CCTP modules, and tiered by evidence strength. Patient-level pseudobulk (three TOF versus five donors), permutation-validated Compartment Dysregulation Index (CMDI), Cross-Species Concordance Score (CSCS), STRING protein-protein interaction analysis, and diffusion pseudotime on 17,290 Ho organoid cells were performed. Results. Among 1,263 unique CCTP-associated hits, 396 genes recurred in at least two dataset tables (exploratory tier; Tier A endothelial anchor n = 24 from Zulibiya et al.). Only Zulibiya endothelial M1 structural-assembly CMDI exceeded a module-size-matched permutation null (p = 0.015). Patient-level pseudobulk returned zero false-discovery-rate-significant CCTP genes. CCTP-conditioned overlap with recent ciliary genetics was non-significant (Fisher p {approx} 0.13). Ho organoid pseudotime showed highest M1/M2 activity at day 8, declining toward day 21. Genome-wide CSCS classified 11 genes as fully conserved and 136 as partially conserved among scoreable orthologs. Conclusions. Ciliary transcriptional correlates in TOF are compartment-specific and module-structured, with the strongest inferential signal in TOF endothelium (M1). CCTP-Atlas provides a reproducible, tiered prioritisation resource linking public TOF snRNA-seq, organoid maturation proxies, and partial cross-species patterns. Findings are hypothesis-generating and complement but do not replicate recent ciliary genetics evidence until expanded cohorts and functional validation are performed. Data availability. Processed gene lists, manifests, and scripts. Source datasets: GSE203274, GSE168464, GSE166462, GSE126128; Li et al. (2025) supplementary tables. This is a preprint and has not been peer-reviewed.
papers.titleZh: CCTP-Atlas：四腔心室缺損中區室解析的纖毛轉錄失調整合分析
papers.summaryZh: 本研究以六組公開心臟單細胞／單核RNA定序資料為基礎，建立包含1,611個基因、劃分為四個模組的心臟纖毛轉錄體面板CCTP，並以十階段整合流程進行分析。作者將差異表現基因表統一標準後對應至CCTP模組並分層，發現1,263個獨特CCTP相關命中中，有396個基因在至少兩組資料表中重複出現，其中Zulibiya等人的內皮細胞Tier A錨定為24個。僅Zulibiya內皮M1結構組裝模組的區室失調指數CMDI超過模組大小配對的置換零分布，p值為0.015。患者層級偽體積分析未得到任何FDR顯著的CCTP基因，且CCTP條件下的基因重疊與近期纖毛遺傳學結果無顯著關聯，Fisher p約0.13。Ho類器官擴散偽時間顯示M1/M2活性在第8天最高，至第21天下降，基因組層級跨物種一致性評分CSCS則將11個基因評為完全保守、136個為部分保守。作者結論為TOF中纖毛轉錄相關變化具區室特異性與模組結構，推論訊號最強於內皮M1，並提供可重現的分層優先化資源。

papers.title: De novo transformer modeling improves recovery of genetic cell types from sparse single-cell RNA sequencing
papers.abstract: Single-cell RNA sequencing (scRNA-seq) simultaneously provides gene-expression profiles and genetic variants from individual cells, creating an opportunity to relate cellular phenotypes to their somatic evolutionary histories. However, delineating genetic types (GTs) from scRNA-seq remains difficult because most bases remain undetected in each cellular genome and are accompanied by false-positive and false-negative base calls. We evaluated some existing phylogenetic and imputation methods for GT inference using one simulated and two empirical tumor datasets. We found that the extreme sparsity of cell-variant (CV) alignments produced by scRNA-seq data prevented reliable GT recovery, particularly when multiple GTs were present. This led us to explore a transformer-based genotype imputation system (STICI), which has been shown to reduce sparsity in germline genomes. However, STICI was trained on germline sequence variation in the human population, making it inapplicable for imputing idiosyncratic somatic variation in tumor genomes. We tested the hypothesis that a STICI model trained on observed bases in a given CV alignment can predict missing bases in that dataset. We found that sample-specific STICI (ssSTICI) models predicted many missing bases with high imputation probabilities, and the resulting CV alignments placed the constituent cells of each GT closer together in the inferred cellular phylogenies. Therefore, sample-specific deep learning models show strong potential to reduce CV alignment sparsity, paving the way for integrative studies of sequence and expression evolution using scRNA-seq and similar technologies.
papers.titleZh: De novo Transformer 模型改進稀疏單細胞 RNA 定序中遺傳細胞類型的恢復

papers.title: CellWHISPER disentangles direct cell-cell communication from structural proximity
papers.abstract: Spatial transcriptomics makes it possible to infer direct, contact-dependent cellular communication, but existing tools are prone to high error rates due to spatial structure in cell types and gene expression. We present CellWHISPER, a framework for inferring contact-mediated communication, including gap junctions and ligand-receptor signaling, from spatial transcriptomics data. CellWHISPER controls errors with a statistical procedure that accounts for confounding effects of cell-type-specific expression and spatial organization. Closed-form significance scores enable analysis of large data. A latent variable model distills recurrent patterns into maps of preferences among cell types and signaling genes. We demonstrate CellWHISPER on two technologies (Stereo-seq, Xenium), two species and three tissues. In mouse brain it yields a comprehensive connexin-interaction map. Immunostaining confirmed CellWHISPER-predicted Connexin 43-mediated interfaces among astrocytes, microglia and endothelial cells, which existing approaches fail to prioritize. In human colon and skin, tissues with strong spatial gradients, CellWHISPER recovers communication mechanisms both along and independent of the gradient.
papers.titleZh: CellWHISPER 區分直接細胞間通訊與結構鄰近性

papers.title: Predicting Pre-treatment Resistance or Post-treatment Effect? A Systematic Benchmarking of Single-Cell Drug Response Models
papers.abstract: Intratumoral heterogeneity drives variable drug responses in cancer. Single-cell RNA sequencing (scRNA-seq) enables characterization of such heterogeneity and prediction of drug response at single-cell resolution. Accordingly, various computational models have been developed to infer drug response from scRNA-seq data. However, their performance, robustness, and generalizability across different biological contexts remain insufficiently evaluated. To address this gap, we benchmarked representative single-cell drug response prediction models using 26 curated datasets comprising over 760,000 cells across 12 cancer types and 21 therapeutic agents. We constructed balanced and imbalanced scenarios to explore model behavior under different label distributions. To address the lack of ground-truth labels in conventional scRNA-seq datasets, we incorporated two lineage-tracing datasets with experimentally validated drug-response annotations, enabling evaluation in a clinically relevant pre-treatment prediction setting. Our results show that prediction performance was markedly higher in cell lines than in tissue samples and varied substantially across datasets, treatment types, and imbalance levels. Under increasing class imbalance, several methods showed reduced performance, and no single method consistently dominated across all evaluation settings. In lineage-tracing datasets, treatment-associated states were more readily distinguished than lineage-defined pre-sensitive and pre-resistant states, while transcriptomic analyses indicated that pre-existing resistance-related signals were detectable but relatively subtle. For scDEAL, which showed competitive performance across several benchmark settings, label-substitution and ablation analyses further indicated that its performance was jointly influenced by training-label definition and architectural design. Application to an independent PDAC organoid dataset showed that scDEAL predictions were associated with treatment-related transcriptional state changes and biological programs. In summary, our study systematically characterizes the performance and limitations of current single-cell drug response prediction approaches across diverse evaluation settings. These results highlight the influence of dataset characteristics, class imbalance, training design, and the strength of resistance-associated signals on model performance, providing a reference for the evaluation and further development of single-cell drug response prediction methods.
papers.titleZh: 預測治療前抗藥性或治療後效應？單細胞藥物反應模型的系統性基準測試

papers.title: SpacePath enables pathway and molecular-family analysis beyond annotation ambiguity in spatial metabolomics and lipidomics
papers.abstract: Mass spectrometry imaging (MSI) maps metabolites and lipids in tissue with spatial resolution, but molecular identity remains partly resolved: single ions match multiple candidate compounds, and most detected metabolites and lipids fall outside canonical biochemical pathways. We developed SpacePath, a computational framework that retains ion-to-compound ambiguity, scores canonical pathways across tissue locations, and groups assignments that were unmapped to pathways into de novo molecular families by chemical similarity. Pathway mappings covered on average only 1% of molecular assignments, whereas the combined SpacePath representation covered 24% of pooled assignments. Benchmarking on four public spatial lipidomics datasets (healthy mouse brain, cerebellum, a demyelination model, and human bladder cancer) recovered previously reported spatial patterns. In newly acquired glioblastoma xenograft datasets, SpacePath identified lipid programs specific to tumor and surrounding brain, and SpiderMass-MS/MS independently confirmed four tumor-associated features from a de novo family, refining the initial MS1 assignments. SpacePath extends the spatial interpretation of MSI data beyond canonical pathways while preserving annotation uncertainty.
papers.titleZh: SpacePath 實現空間代謝體學與脂質體學中超越註釋模糊性的路徑與分子家族分析

papers.title: Cell-level integration of gene expression and B cell receptor data captures complementary B cell information
papers.abstract: Single-cell B cell analyses commonly define relationships among cells using gene expression (GEX), although paired B cell receptor (BCR) sequences provide complementary information about receptor features, differentiation, and clonal relationships. We evaluated multiple approaches for integrating paired GEX and BCR data into cell-level representations and compared their ability to capture complementary aspects of B cell biology. We compared BCR representations based on language-model embeddings and engineered sequence features across multiple integration strategies. Spaces dominated by BCR language-model embeddings captured broad sequence and clonal information but could distort cell type relationships, as assessed using independent cell surface protein measurements. In contrast, concatenating GEX with selected BCR features (isotype, somatic hypermutation frequency, and CDRH3 length) incorporated receptor information while retaining transcriptional and surface-protein-associated structure. The resulting space reduced discordance between GEX-based cell type annotations and BCR characteristics and revealed B-cell substructure supported by both transcriptional and receptor-derived features. Thus, integrating GEX and BCR data captures complementary biological information and provides a richer foundation for single-cell B cell analysis.
papers.titleZh: 單細胞層級整合基因表現與 B 細胞受體資料
papers.summaryZh: 本研究評估多種方法，將配對的基因表現（GEX）與 B 細胞受體（BCR）資料整合為細胞層級的表徵，並比較其捕捉 B 細胞生物學互補面向的能力。研究比較了基於語言模型嵌入與工程化序列特徵的 BCR 表徵，並在不同整合策略下進行評估。以 BCR 語言模型嵌入為主的空間能捕捉廣泛的序列與克隆資訊，但會扭曲細胞型別關係，此點以獨立的細胞表面蛋白測量作為評估。相較之下，將 GEX 與選定的 BCR 特徵（同型、體細胞超突變頻率與 CDRH3 長度）串接，能在保留轉錄與表面蛋白相關結構的同時納入受體資訊。該表徵空間降低了 GEX 為基礎的細胞型別註解與 BCR 特徵間的不一致，並揭示同時受轉錄與受體衍生特徵支持的 B 細胞亞結構。作者認為整合 GEX 與 BCR 資料可捕捉互補的生物學資訊，為單細胞 B 細胞分析提供更豐富的基礎。

papers.title: GeoSinkhorn Flow: Geometry-Aware Flow Matching for Perturbation-Conditioned Dynamics in Single cell Data Phenoscapes
papers.abstract: Single-cell technologies increasingly enable large-scale profiling of complex biological systems across many experimental perturbations, but understanding how a system reorganizes across an entire space of conditions is difficult to interpret from single-cell embeddings alone. Phenoscapes address this by embedding entire cell-state distributions, rather than individual cells, as points in a data-driven landscape. Thus, a single dot represents one experimental condition rather than one cell, yielding a map of the perturbation or patient landscape that reveals how phenotype varies continuously across conditions. Phenoscapes remain a comparatively new and underexplored representation and existing static phenoscapes position experimental conditions relative to one another without specifying trajectories that describe how a cellular population moves from one condition to another. Flow- and trajectory-based models for single-cell data are numerous, but existing approaches operate at the level of individual cells, are not built to respect the geometry of a phenoscape, and typically cannot generalize their predicted flows to conditions not seen during training. Here we introduce GeoSinkhorn Flow, a perturbation-conditioned, geometry-aware flow-matching framework specialized designed to convert a static phenoscape into a dynamic phenoscape, in which each condition-level point is additionally connected by geodesic, condition-aware transport trajectories that are consistent with the phenoscape's underlying geometry. GeoSinkhorn Flow can also model transitions directly between time points without constructing a phenoscape. GeoSinkhorn Flow uses heat-diffusion geometry to define manifold-aware transport costs and trains a geometric autoencoder whose latent Euclidean distances stay aligned with the static phenoscape geometry while extending it to unseen cells. By explicitly conditioning the learned transport dynamics on perturbation-specific gene or drug embeddings, GeoSinkhorn Flow generalizes its trajectories to new measurement conditions, produces intermediate progression states along a trajectory, and extends predictions to unseen cells and held-out perturbations. An unbalanced optimal transport variant further learns growth or transition weights, so that changes in relative cell-state abundance or transition propensity are modeled together with state movement. Across synthetic manifolds, patient-derived organoid drug responses, Perturb-seq knockdowns, and time-resolved CyTOF signaling, GeoSinkhorn Flow recovered intrinsic manifold geometry, inferred biologically coherent response trajectories, and generalized to held-out drug combinations, perturbation genes, and time points. Together, these results establish GeoSinkhorn Flow as a perturbation-conditioned, phenoscape-consistent dynamical framework, distinct from standard flow-matching approaches, for converting static phenoscapes into dynamic ones that generalize across experimental conditions.
papers.titleZh: GeoSinkhorn Flow：單細胞數據表型景觀中擾動條件動態的幾何感知流匹配

papers.title: Decoding Cell-level Circadian Phase and Rhythm-state Remodeling in Single-cell Transcriptomes With scRhythmBayes
papers.abstract: Current circadian omics analysis tools have been developed primarily for bulk time-series. However, heterogeneous single-cell datasets require analysis and interpretation of rhythmic programs across different cells, cell types, and biological conditions. In these datasets, cellular circadian phase is usually unobserved, and sample-level zeitgeber time provides temporal information but does not define the exact phase of every cell. Existing methods address only selected aspects of this problem and do not model how cell-level phase evidence informs gene-level rhythmic parameters and rhythm-state remodeling. Here we present scRhythmBayes, a new probabilistic algorithm for phase-resolved circadian analysis in heterogeneous single-cell transcriptomes. scRhythmBayes combines a seed-gene count likelihood with a stratum-aware circular prior to infer cell-level circadian phase, incorporates phase support into gene-level rhythmic modeling, and assigns posterior probabilities to interpretable rhythm-state categories, including rhythm gain, rhythm loss, amplitude remodeling and phase shifts. In heterogeneous simulations, scRhythmBayes achieved higher phase-recovery accuracy than existing phase-inference methods and maintained balanced performance across rhythmic gene detection, parameter recovery, and rhythm-state classification. Stress tests defined practical requirements for seed-gene support, zeitgeber anchoring, temporal sampling density, and cell number. In mouse liver, scRhythmBayes revealed distinct circadian phase occupancy and rhythm-state organization between periportal and pericentral hepatocytes, supporting a temporal dimension of liver zonation. It also identified cell-type-specific rhythmic markers that were largely distinct from conventional static markers, indicating that cellular identity includes temporal programs not captured by average expression. In human heart disease data, phase-coordination and phase-distribution analyses identified cell-type-selective temporal disorganization rather than uniform circadian disruption across the tissue. scRhythmBayes therefore provides a statistically grounded approach for resolving circadian organization across cells, genes, cell types and biological conditions.
papers.titleZh: 以 scRhythmBayes 解碼單細胞轉錄組中細胞層級的晝夜節律相位與節律狀態重塑

papers.title: SPATNIC enables H&E-grounded cancer-cell identification across spatial and single-cell transcriptomic modalities in colorectal cancer
papers.abstract: Tumors contain diverse non-cancer cells that constitute the tumor microenvironment; thus, identifying which cells are cancerous is a foundational and critical first step in cancer research. However, to our knowledge, no transcriptome-based classifier has been trained using pathologist-defined annotations from matched H&E images at single-cell resolution. Moreover, few tools can be shared across diverse platforms. Here, we present SPATNIC, a variational autoencoder that classifies individual cells as cancer or normal, trained on Xenium cells labeled by a pathologist review of matched H&E images. It matches or exceeds the performance of existing tools in primary colorectal tumors and liver and lung metastases. SPATNIC generalizes zero-shot across Visium, Visium HD, CosMx, Xenium, MERSCOPE, and single-cell RNA sequencing. In public single-cell atlases, it identified a rare POU2F3 tuft-like cancer stem cell population missed by existing annotations and associated with worse survival. In rectal cancer profiled before and after chemoradiotherapy, it separated cancer from normal epithelium in tissue, thus enabling per-patient screening of antibody-drug conjugate (ADC) targets.
papers.titleZh: SPATNIC 實現結直腸癌中跨空間與單細胞轉錄組模態的以 H&E 為基礎的癌細胞識別

papers.title: Tumour architecture shapes polarized epithelial states that predict survival in high-grade serous ovarian cancer
papers.abstract: High-grade serous ovarian carcinoma (HGSC) is among the most genomically unstable cancers, yet how this diversity relates to malignant-cell states and how they influence treatment response remain unclear. Integrating 1.98 million single-cell transcriptomes across 13 studies, we identify a dominant axis of polarization in malignant secretory cells, from proliferative, progenitor-like (SecA) to quiescent, injury-like (SecB) states that recur across patients and coexist within genetic clones. Spatial profiling of eight whole tumors and tissue microarrays from 378 patients links this polarization to tumor architecture: SecB cells occupy avascular, hypoxic niches, where they adopt HIF/NF-{kappa}B survival programs, exclude lymphocytes, and co-organize with macrophages exhibiting similar glycolytic states. Their localization and enrichment in ascites link SecB to metastasis. SecB predicts poor survival across independent cohorts, but preferential benefit from bevacizumab in the ICON7 trial. Together, these findings reveal shared malignant phenotypes across genomically diverse tumors and highlight their potential to guide treatment selection.
papers.titleZh: 腫瘤結構塑造可預測高級別漿液性卵巢癌存活的極化上皮狀態
